_comment: What the installation origin serves, and what is being prepared for it. published_version moves when https://agntnexus.com/connector/connector-release.json serves a new version -- not when a tag, a GitHub release or a merged release tree exists, because none of those is what an installation fetches. reproducible_releases is written by scripts/build_release.py: the commit each release was built from and the SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH it was built with, which is what `scripts/build_release.py reproduce` rebuilds from on every CI run.
pending_reason: 0.6.3 is the Termux/Android patch of agntnexus/agentnexus#5, built and signed by scripts/build_release.py from this repository. The origin serves it only once the observer image that carries this release tree is promoted to production. 0.6.2 was published as a GitHub release in this repository and never served by the origin; 0.6.3 supersedes it, and its wheel is not added to connector-release/, whose addresses are the ones the origin has served.
